article_title: How to protect your laptop, phone and bike from thieves at uni

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly designed to help university students do?
options: Protect valuable belongings and choose suitable insurance cover
Find the cheapest university accommodation
Apply for work at an insurance company
Choose a new laptop model
tasks.correct_answer: Protect valuable belongings and choose suitable insurance cover
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה משלבת עצות למניעת גניבה עם הסבר כיצד לבדוק ולבחור כיסוי ביטוחי מתאים.

tasks.prompt: Where does the article say insured student items may be stolen from?
options: Only university libraries
Digs, cars, public transport, bars and restaurants
Only university-managed halls
Sports grounds and lecture theatres only
tasks.correct_answer: Digs, cars, public transport, bars and restaurants
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת מגורים, מכוניות, תחבורה ציבורית, ברים ומסעדות כמקומות שמהם נגנבו פריטים.

tasks.prompt: What does “portability” mean when Aviva explains why phones and laptops attract thieves?
options: Their ability to store information
Their high repair cost
The ease with which they can be carried away
Their need for frequent charging
tasks.correct_answer: The ease with which they can be carried away
tasks.explanation_hebrew: portability היא ניידות — קל לשאת את המכשירים ולכן גם קל לגנוב אותם במהירות.

tasks.prompt: Which type of insurance does the article say is compulsory?
options: Bike insurance
Laptop insurance
Contents insurance
Car insurance
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי איגוד המבטחים הבריטי, ביטוח רכב הוא חובה; ביטוח אופניים וחפצים אחרים נתון לבחירה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the ABI recommend making an inventory of clothes, electronics and furniture?
options: To check whether the total cover is enough to replace everything
To prove every possession was bought recently
To decide which items must remain at home
To lower the legal cost of car insurance
tasks.correct_answer: To check whether the total cover is enough to replace everything
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סכימת עלויות ההחלפה מאפשרת לבדוק אם סכום הכיסוי הכולל והמגבלה לפריט יחיד מספיקים.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean if a parent's insurance policy “extends to” a student?
options: The policy lasts for more years
The policy may also cover the student's belongings
The policy covers only items kept in a car
The insurer must replace every stolen item
tasks.correct_answer: The policy may also cover the student's belongings
tasks.explanation_hebrew: extends to פירושו שהכיסוי מתרחב ויכול לחול גם על הסטודנט או הסטודנטית.

tasks.prompt: List Steven Jackson's practical advice for reducing the risk of theft.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין השארת חפצים יקרים או סנטימנטליים בבית, נעילת חפצי ערך והרחקתם מהעין, ושמירה על ערנות.
expected_points: Leave especially expensive and sentimental belongings at home
Lock valuables and keep them out of sight
Stay vigilant in cafés and libraries
Do not leave a bag or laptop unattended to reserve a place

tasks.prompt: Explain how a student can check whether an insurance policy gives adequate cover.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר בדיקת כיסוי קיים, סכומי כיסוי, מגבלה לפריט יחיד, מלאי ותוספות אפשריות.
expected_points: Check halls insurance or a parent's policy first
Read total and single-item limits
Create an inventory and add replacement costs
Consider extra cover for an expensive bike or portable items

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's advice on theft prevention, contents insurance and car insurance.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את הסיכון, צעדי המניעה, בדיקת הכיסוי ועדכון מבטח הרכב.
expected_points: Laptops, phones and bikes are common targets
Students should secure and watch valuables
Existing halls or parental cover should be checked
Contents insurance may cover damaged, destroyed or stolen possessions
Cover limits must match replacement costs
The car insurer must know the location and main driver

tasks.prompt: Write a short pre-university checklist for protecting and insuring your belongings.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב רשימת בדיקה באנגלית הכוללת מניעת גניבה, בדיקת פוליסה, מלאי ועדכון ביטוח רכב.
expected_points: Identify valuable and sentimental items
Plan secure storage
Check existing insurance
List replacement values and limits
Add special cover if needed
Inform the car insurer of relevant changes
